name: site-shot
description: Website screenshots for AI agents: real Chromium, full-page capture, ISO-code country proxies, automatic ad & cookie-banner removal. Wraps the published site-shot-mcp stdio server.

SITESHOT_API_KEY.title: Site-Shot API key
SITESHOT_API_KEY.description: Your Site-Shot API key (sent to the API as userkey). A confirmed account's API key comes with a free API trial of 100 captures a month, no card needed; paid plans from $5/mo for 2,000 add volume. Trial captures come from the default location or the US; other countries need a paid plan. Get the key from your Site-Shot dashboard (https://www.site-shot.com/dashboard/); plans are listed at https://www.site-shot.com/pricing/.
